sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Aim Drills is a Combat skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Aim drills will increase your aiming speed and will allow to perform aiming quieter.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Increases aiming speed (1% per level → +50% at Elite Level)
- Reduces aiming sound (1% per level → -50% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: No hand shaking at any stamina value, first 2 seconds after aiming
- Elite level: Reduced hands shaking during tremor and fracture, the first 2 seconds after aiming

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- 0.2 points for any hits landed on enemies while aiming down sights (ADS).
- Completing the quest Profitable Venture
- Completing the quest Consolation Prize
- Completing the quest Safety Guarantee
